status: proposed deterministic QA scenarios; NOT EXECUTED

items.query: DataRoot bootstrap interrupted between pending intent and canonical readback
acceptance: per-boundary crash matrix
new process readback and no accidental empty database

items.query: Stop requested while worker blocked and late IPC completion arrives after new start
acceptance: Stop does not claim done before join
stale callback does not update current generation

items.query: Xray rollout failed and rollback itself reports partial error
acceptance: rollback failure has distinct status
known-good configuration not silently overwritten

items.query: IPC deadline and retry tested without wall clock sleeps
acceptance: fake clock advances deadline deterministically
explicit comparison before and after deadline

items.query: unit tests pass but actual USB audio buffer stability not measured
acceptance: synthetic PASS not promoted to hardware PASS
real endpoint, format, jitter and duration evidence required

items.query: parallel CI runs use same temp folder and fail intermittently
acceptance: per-run unique temp root
no colliding artifacts or unsafe automatic cancellation

items.query: Concurrent SQLite writes restart backup until deadline; BUSY/LOCKED transient but IOERR fatal
acceptance: synthetic clock enforces total deadline; no infinite loop
finish exactly once after successful init on DONE, fatal and cancel
destination not published without DONE and integrity/foreign-key checks
old DataRoot and pending intent preserved after failed copy

items.query: SQLite COMMIT returns BUSY or IOERR/FULL/INTERRUPT inside DataRoot transaction
acceptance: SYNTHETIC two-connection contention verifies BUSY does not imply commit and retries are bounded
injected fatal errors require explicit transaction-state inspection and rollback policy
pending DataRoot intent survives unknown or failed transaction; no premature publish

items.query: Canonical DataRoot file replacement fails with Win32 1175/1176/1177 or target is on another volume
acceptance: SYNTHETIC 1175/1176/1177 scenarios inspect all named candidate and backup files before cleanup
cross-volume copy succeeds but source delete fails: both verified generations remain until reconciliation
restart after interrupted target copy never publishes incomplete candidate or silently initializes an empty database
pending intent is retained until canonical, marker and SQLite RootId readback agree

items.query: Common operation must select different compatible implementation without changing its orchestration
acceptance: synthetic variants share orchestration and return distinct compatible implementations
construction failure does not execute downstream operation

items.query: Two dependent adapter objects must not be mixed across incompatible families
acceptance: synthetic family matrix rejects mismatched pairs
failed construction does not publish a partial family
